TESE: Todo site top é feito de 10 códigos. Quem domina os 10, domina tudo.

================================================================================
CODIGO 1: O SCROLL SAGRADO - O QUE FAZ APPLE PARECER APPLE
================================================================================

Segredo: Apple não usa scroll nativo. Usa Lenis com lag 0 e GSAP ticker sync + normalizeScroll.
Se você só coloca Lenis, fica mole. O segredo é o sync perfeito.

Código que domina tudo:
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import ScrollTrigger from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

const lenis = new Lenis({
  duration: 1.2,
  easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)),
  smoothWheel: true,
  smoothTouch: false,
  syncTouch: false,
  gestureOrientation: 'vertical',
  touchMultiplier: 1.5,
  infinite: false
})

// O SEGREDO QUE NINGUÉM MOSTRA:
lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
gsap.ticker.add((time) => {
  lenis.raf(time * 1000)
})
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0) // Apple faz isso, senão fica com delay

// Normalize scroll entre trackpad e mouse wheel (Apple faz)
ScrollTrigger.normalizeScroll(true)

// Parallax sem data-attribute, com velocidade real
lenis.on('scroll', ({ velocity, scroll })=>{
  const v = velocity * 0.01
  gsap.to('.parallax-slow', { y: scroll * 0.2 + v * 10, overwrite: 'auto', duration: 0.8 })
  gsap.to('.parallax-fast', { y: scroll * -0.3 + v * -5, overwrite: 'auto', duration: 0.8 })
})

Por que isso domina: 90% dos devs colocam Lenis e ScrollTrigger separados. Fica com jank. Com ticker sync + lagSmoothing(0), fica 60fps igual Apple.

Treino agente: "Sempre que usar Lenis + ScrollTrigger, use ticker sync + lagSmoothing(0) + normalizeScroll. Nunca use scroll event nativo."

================================================================================
CODIGO 2: A LUZ QUE RESPIRA - SHADER DA STRIPE E LINEAR
================================================================================

Segredo: Stripe não usa imagem. Usa SDF circle + noise + palette com uTime que respira com idle, não com loop infinito.

Código:
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'

const BreathLightMat = shaderMaterial(
  { uTime: 0, uIdle: 0, uPointer: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5), uVel: 0 },
  `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  `
  #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
  #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
  #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
  varying vec2 vUv;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uIdle;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;
  uniform float uVel;

  void main(){
    vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.2; // segue pointer sutil

    // RESPIRAÇÃO: idle aumenta, respiração mais profunda
    float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle * 0.2) * (0.05 + uIdle * 0.02);
    breath += uVel * 0.1; // velocidade aumenta respiração

    float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
    float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
    d += n * (0.5 + uVel);

    vec3 col = palette(d * 2.0 + uTime * 0.1,
      vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));

    float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, d);
    alpha *= 0.6 - uVel * 0.2; // rápido fica mais transparente

    gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha);
  }
  `
)

JS que faz respirar sem mic:
let lastScroll = performance.now()
let idle = 0
lenis.on('scroll', ()=> lastScroll = performance.now())

function raf(t){
  idle = (performance.now() - lastScroll) / 1000
  mat.uniforms.uTime.value = t * 0.001
  mat.uniforms.uIdle.value = Math.min(5, idle) // máximo 5s de idle
  requestAnimationFrame(raf)
}

Domina porque: Todo site usa `sin(uTime)` que parece robô. Com `uIdle`, quando usuário para, luz respira fundo, convida a ficar. É humano.

Treino agente: "Nunca use sin(uTime) puro. Sempre multiplique por uIdle + uVel para respiração humana."

================================================================================
CODIGO 3: A MEMORIA INFINITA - GPGPU 50k PARTICULAS DA APPLE E ACTIVE THEORY
================================================================================

Segredo: Apple AirPods page com 10k partículas não usa Points. Usa GPGPU com 2 render targets (position + velocity) e compute shader em WebGL2, agora WebGPU.

Código que domina (Three.js WebGL2 GPGPU, sem WebGPU ainda para compat):
import { GPUComputationRenderer } from 'three/addons/misc/GPUComputationRenderer.js'

const gpuCompute = new GPUComputationRenderer(256, 256, renderer) // 256*256 = 65536 partículas
const dtPosition = gpuCompute.createTexture()
const dtVelocity = gpuCompute.createTexture()

// Inicializa posições aleatórias esfera
for(let i=0; i<256*256*4; i+=4){
  dtPosition.image.data[i] = (Math.random()-0.5) * 10
  dtPosition.image.data[i+1] = (Math.random()-0.5) * 10
  dtPosition.image.data[i+2] = (Math.random()-0.5) * 10
}

const posVar = gpuCompute.addVariable('texturePosition', `
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uScrollProgress;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;
  void main(){
    vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / resolution.xy;
    vec4 pos = texture2D(texturePosition, uv);
    vec4 vel = texture2D(textureVelocity, uv);

    // Scroll apaga: se progress > vida, partícula morre e renasce
    float life = 1.0 - uScrollProgress + fract(sin(dot(uv, vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453) * 0.2;
    if(life < 0.0){
      pos.xyz = vec3((random(uv)-0.5)*10.0);
    } else {
      pos.xyz += vel.xyz * 0.01;
      pos.xyz += vec3(sin(uTime + uv.x * 10.0) * 0.01);
    }

    gl_FragColor = pos;
  }
`, dtPosition)

gpuCompute.init()

// No render loop:
gpuCompute.compute()
particlesMaterial.uniforms.texturePosition.value = gpuCompute.getCurrentRenderTarget(posVar).texture

Domina porque: 50k partículas em CPU morre. Em GPGPU, GPU calcula, 60fps em mobile.

Treino agente: "Para >10k partículas, sempre GPGPU. Nunca Points com loop JS."

================================================================================
CODIGO 4: A TRANSICAO IMPOSSIVEL - FLIP DA LINEAR
================================================================================

Segredo: Linear quando clica num card, ele expande para modal sem flash. Não é route. É Flip.getState() + absolute + scale.

Código que domina:
import Flip from 'gsap/Flip'

function expandCard(card){
  const state = Flip.getState(card, { props: "borderRadius,backgroundColor" })

  card.classList.add('expanded') // CSS: position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;

  Flip.from(state, {
    duration: 0.7,
    ease: 'power2.inOut',
    absolute: true, // segredo: usa position absolute durante animação para não quebrar layout
    scale: true,
    simple: true,
    onEnter: (elements) => gsap.from(elements, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }),
    onLeave: (elements) => gsap.to(elements, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 })
  })
}

Para lista:
function filterList(){
  const state = Flip.getState('.card')
  // muda DOM: esconde alguns cards
  document.querySelectorAll('.card.hidden').forEach(c=>c.style.display='none')
  Flip.from(state, {
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: 'power2.out',
    stagger: 0.02,
    absolute: true
  })
}

Domina porque: Todo mundo faz modal com opacity. Flip faz layout animar como se fosse nativo.

Treino agente: "Para expandir card, lista, ou mudar layout, sempre Flip.getState + Flip.from com absolute:true. Nunca top/left manual."

================================================================================
CODIGO 5: O TEXTO QUE DERRETE - BRUNO SIMON E ACTIVE THEORY
================================================================================

Segredo: Texto que derrete não é SplitText. É SDF + shader + displacement.

Código:
import SplitType from 'split-type'
const text = new SplitType('.melt-text', { types: 'chars' })

text.chars.forEach((char, i)=>{
  // Cada char é um canvas com shader
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { uProgress: { value: 0 }, uTime: { value: 0 } },
    vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      #include "lygia/generative/cnoise.glsl"
      uniform float uProgress;
      uniform float uTime;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main(){
        vec2 uv = vUv;
        uv.y -= uProgress * 0.5; // derrete pra baixo
        uv.x += cnoise(uv * 5.0 + uTime) * uProgress * 0.2; // ruído aumenta com progress
        float alpha = 1.0 - uProgress;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(0.0), alpha);
      }
    `
  })

  gsap.to(mat.uniforms.uProgress, {
    value: 1,
    duration: 1.2,
    delay: i * 0.02,
    ease: 'power2.in',
    scrollTrigger: {
      trigger: char,
      start: 'top 80%',
      toggleActions: 'play none none reverse'
    }
  })
})

Domina porque: SplitText sozinho é só y. Com shader cnoise, derrete orgânico.

Treino agente: "Para texto premium, SplitType + shader com cnoise + uProgress por char. Nunca só GSAP y."

================================================================================
CODIGO 6: O HOVER QUE DISTORCE - STRIPE E AWWWARDS
================================================================================

Segredo: Imagem que distorce no hover não é filter: blur. É OGL com displacement texture + uMouse.

Código OGL que domina (12kB, não Pixi):
import { Renderer, Camera, Transform, Plane, Program, Mesh, Texture } from 'ogl'

const renderer = new Renderer({ dpr: Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio) })
const gl = renderer.gl
document.body.appendChild(gl.canvas)

const geometry = new Plane(gl, { width: 1, height: 1, widthSegments: 20, heightSegments: 20 })

const program = new Program(gl, {
  vertex: `
    attribute vec3 position;
    attribute vec2 uv;
    uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;
    uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform vec2 uMouse;
    uniform float uHover;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vUv = uv;
      vec3 pos = position;
      float dist = distance(uv, uMouse);
      pos.z += sin(dist * 10.0 - uTime * 2.0) * uHover * 0.1;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragment: `
    precision highp float;
    uniform sampler2D tMap;
    uniform float uHover;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vec2 uv = vUv;
      uv.x += sin(uv.y * 10.0) * uHover * 0.01;
      gl_FragColor = texture2D(tMap, uv);
    }
  `,
  uniforms: {
    tMap: { value: new Texture(gl, { image: new Image() }) },
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uMouse: { value: [0.5,0.5] },
    uHover: { value: 0 }
  }
})

const mesh = new Mesh(gl, { geometry, program })

// Hover:
el.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
  program.uniforms.uMouse.value = [(e.clientX - rect.left)/rect.width, 1.0 - (e.clientY - rect.top)/rect.height]
})

el.addEventListener('pointerenter', ()=> gsap.to(program.uniforms.uHover, { value: 1, duration: 0.6 }))
el.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=> gsap.to(program.uniforms.uHover, { value: 0, duration: 0.8 }))

Domina porque: CSS hover é 2D. OGL é 3D com vértice.

Treino agente: "Para hover premium, OGL Plane + uMouse + uHover. Nunca CSS transform."

CODIGO 7: O TEMPO QUE NAO VOLTA - LETHE - CODIGO MAIS PODEROSO
================================================================================

Segredo: Site que não deixa voltar atrás cria valor. É maxProgress.

Código que domina tudo:
let maxProgress = 0
let isErasing = false

lenis.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  if(isErasing) return

  if(progress > maxProgress){
    maxProgress = progress

    // Apaga memórias com stagger + ruído humano
    document.querySelectorAll('.memory').forEach((el, i)=>{
      const triggerProgress = i / document.querySelectorAll('.memory').length
      if(maxProgress > triggerProgress){
        const delay = Math.random() * 0.2
        gsap.to(el, {
          opacity: 0,
          y: -50,
          scale: 0.9,
          filter: 'blur(20px) grayscale(1)',
          duration: 1.2,
          delay,
          ease: 'power2.in',
          onComplete: ()=> el.style.display = 'none'
        })
      }
    })

    // GPGPU apaga
    gpgpuUniforms.uErase.value = maxProgress

    if(maxProgress > 0.95 && !isErasing){
      isErasing = true
      gsap.to('.final-white', { opacity: 1, duration: 2, onComplete: ()=>{
        document.body.innerHTML = '<div class="void">Algumas coisas só existem se você não tentar guardar. <button onclick="location.reload()">Recomeçar</button></div>'
      }})
    }
  }
})

Domina porque: Quebra expectativa de scroll reversível. Cria ritual, não página.

Treino agente: "Para criar arte com peso emocional, use maxProgress que só aumenta. Nunca progress que volta."

================================================================================
CODIGO 8: A FISICA QUE SENTE - RAPIER + SPRING DA LINEAR
================================================================================

Segredo: Botão da Linear não usa ease. Usa spring com damping que sente velocity do pointer.

Código:
import { useSpring, animated } from '@react-spring/web'

const [props, api] = useSpring(()=> ({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, config: { tension: 300, friction: 20 } }))

function onPointerMove(e){
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
  const x = (e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width/2) * 0.1
  const y = (e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height/2) * 0.1
  api.start({ x, y, scale: 1.05 })
}

function onPointerLeave(){
  api.start({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 })
}

<animated.div style={{ x: props.x, y: props.y, scale: props.scale }} />

Com Rapier para 3D que sente:
import { RigidBody } from '@react-three/rapier'

<RigidBody type="dynamic" colliders="ball" linearDamping={0.5} angularDamping={0.5}>
  <mesh onPointerMove={(e)=>{
    const impulse = { x: e.movementX * 0.01, y: e.movementY * 0.01, z: 0 }
    body.applyImpulse(impulse)
  }}>
    <sphereGeometry />
  </mesh>
</RigidBody>

Domina porque: Spring sente, ease não sente.

Treino agente: "Para interação que sente, spring com tension/friction, não ease. Para 3D, Rapier impulse baseado em movementX."

CODIGO 10: O RITUAL - COMO TRANSFORMAR SCROLL EM CERIMONIA
================================================================================

Segredo: Site top não tem scroll, tem cerimônia: introdução (respira), revelação (luz), clímax (apaga), vazio (branco).

Código master que junta tudo - TEMPLATE FINAL PARA TREINAR AGENTES:

'use client'
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import ScrollTrigger from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

export function RitualPage(){
  useEffect(()=>{
    // 1. Scroll Sagrado
    const lenis = new Lenis({ duration: 1.2, smoothWheel: true })
    lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
    gsap.ticker.add((t)=> lenis.raf(t*1000))
    gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

    // 2. Luz que respira com idle
    let lastScroll = performance.now()
    let maxProgress = 0
    lenis.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
      lastScroll = performance.now()
      maxProgress = Math.max(maxProgress, progress)

      // Código 7: tempo que não volta
      document.querySelectorAll('.memory').forEach((el,i)=>{
        if(maxProgress > i * 0.1){
          gsap.to(el, { opacity: 0, y: -30, duration: 1, delay: Math.random()*0.2 })
        }
      })
    })

    function raf(t){
      lenis.raf(t)
      const idle = (performance.now() - lastScroll) / 1000
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle', Math.min(5, idle))
      requestAnimationFrame(raf)
    }
    raf()

    // 3. Hover que distorce (Código 6)
    document.querySelectorAll('.distort').forEach(el=>{
      // OGL setup aqui
    })

    // 4. Texto que derrete (Código 5)
    // SplitType + shader

    // 5. Transição impossível (Código 4)
    // Flip

  },[])

  return (
    <>
      <div className="void" style={{ height: '30vh' }} /> {/* Código 9: vazio */}
      <section className="hero">
        <div className="halo" /> {/* Código 2: luz que respira */}
        <h1 className="melt-text">Você não vê o que está lá. Você vê onde ilumina.</h1>
      </section>
      <section className="memories">
        {Array.from({length: 10}).map((_,i)=>(
          <div key={i} className="memory" style={{ '--index': i } as any}>
            Memória {i}
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>
      <div className="void" style={{ height: '50vh' }} />
    </>
  )
}

Esse é o código que domina tudo. Não é biblioteca. É ritual.

================================================================================
CODIGO 1: O SCROLL SAGRADO - O QUE FAZ APPLE PARECER APPLE
================================================================================

Segredo: Apple não usa scroll nativo. Usa Lenis com lag 0 e GSAP ticker sync + normalizeScroll.
Se você só coloca Lenis, fica mole. O segredo é o sync perfeito.

Código que domina tudo:
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import ScrollTrigger from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

const lenis = new Lenis({
  duration: 1.2,
  easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)),
  smoothWheel: true,
  smoothTouch: false,
  syncTouch: false,
  gestureOrientation: 'vertical',
  touchMultiplier: 1.5,
  infinite: false
})

// O SEGREDO QUE NINGUÉM MOSTRA:
lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
gsap.ticker.add((time) => {
  lenis.raf(time * 1000)
})
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0) // Apple faz isso, senão fica com delay

// Normalize scroll entre trackpad e mouse wheel (Apple faz)
ScrollTrigger.normalizeScroll(true)

// Parallax sem data-attribute, com velocidade real
lenis.on('scroll', ({ velocity, scroll })=>{
  const v = velocity * 0.01
  gsap.to('.parallax-slow', { y: scroll * 0.2 + v * 10, overwrite: 'auto', duration: 0.8 })
  gsap.to('.parallax-fast', { y: scroll * -0.3 + v * -5, overwrite: 'auto', duration: 0.8 })
})

Por que isso domina: 90% dos devs colocam Lenis e ScrollTrigger separados. Fica com jank. Com ticker sync + lagSmoothing(0), fica 60fps igual Apple.

Treino agente: "Sempre que usar Lenis + ScrollTrigger, use ticker sync + lagSmoothing(0) + normalizeScroll. Nunca use scroll event nativo."

================================================================================
CODIGO 2: A LUZ QUE RESPIRA - SHADER DA STRIPE E LINEAR
================================================================================

Segredo: Stripe não usa imagem. Usa SDF circle + noise + palette com uTime que respira com idle, não com loop infinito.

Código:
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'

const BreathLightMat = shaderMaterial(
  { uTime: 0, uIdle: 0, uPointer: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5), uVel: 0 },
  `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  `
  #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
  #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
  #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
  varying vec2 vUv;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uIdle;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;
  uniform float uVel;

  void main(){
    vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.2; // segue pointer sutil

    // RESPIRAÇÃO: idle aumenta, respiração mais profunda
    float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle * 0.2) * (0.05 + uIdle * 0.02);
    breath += uVel * 0.1; // velocidade aumenta respiração

    float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
    float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
    d += n * (0.5 + uVel);

    vec3 col = palette(d * 2.0 + uTime * 0.1,
      vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));

    float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, d);
    alpha *= 0.6 - uVel * 0.2; // rápido fica mais transparente

    gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha);
  }
  `
)

JS que faz respirar sem mic:
let lastScroll = performance.now()
let idle = 0
lenis.on('scroll', ()=> lastScroll = performance.now())

function raf(t){
  idle = (performance.now() - lastScroll) / 1000
  mat.uniforms.uTime.value = t * 0.001
  mat.uniforms.uIdle.value = Math.min(5, idle) // máximo 5s de idle
  requestAnimationFrame(raf)
}

Domina porque: Todo site usa `sin(uTime)` que parece robô. Com `uIdle`, quando usuário para, luz respira fundo, convida a ficar. É humano.

Treino agente: "Nunca use sin(uTime) puro. Sempre multiplique por uIdle + uVel para respiração humana."

================================================================================
CODIGO 3: A MEMORIA INFINITA - GPGPU 50k PARTICULAS DA APPLE E ACTIVE THEORY
================================================================================

Segredo: Apple AirPods page com 10k partículas não usa Points. Usa GPGPU com 2 render targets (position + velocity) e compute shader em WebGL2, agora WebGPU.

Código que domina (Three.js WebGL2 GPGPU, sem WebGPU ainda para compat):
import { GPUComputationRenderer } from 'three/addons/misc/GPUComputationRenderer.js'

const gpuCompute = new GPUComputationRenderer(256, 256, renderer) // 256*256 = 65536 partículas
const dtPosition = gpuCompute.createTexture()
const dtVelocity = gpuCompute.createTexture()

// Inicializa posições aleatórias esfera
for(let i=0; i<256*256*4; i+=4){
  dtPosition.image.data[i] = (Math.random()-0.5) * 10
  dtPosition.image.data[i+1] = (Math.random()-0.5) * 10
  dtPosition.image.data[i+2] = (Math.random()-0.5) * 10
}

const posVar = gpuCompute.addVariable('texturePosition', `
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uScrollProgress;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;
  void main(){
    vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / resolution.xy;
    vec4 pos = texture2D(texturePosition, uv);
    vec4 vel = texture2D(textureVelocity, uv);

    // Scroll apaga: se progress > vida, partícula morre e renasce
    float life = 1.0 - uScrollProgress + fract(sin(dot(uv, vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453) * 0.2;
    if(life < 0.0){
      pos.xyz = vec3((random(uv)-0.5)*10.0);
    } else {
      pos.xyz += vel.xyz * 0.01;
      pos.xyz += vec3(sin(uTime + uv.x * 10.0) * 0.01);
    }

    gl_FragColor = pos;
  }
`, dtPosition)

gpuCompute.init()

// No render loop:
gpuCompute.compute()
particlesMaterial.uniforms.texturePosition.value = gpuCompute.getCurrentRenderTarget(posVar).texture

Domina porque: 50k partículas em CPU morre. Em GPGPU, GPU calcula, 60fps em mobile.

Treino agente: "Para >10k partículas, sempre GPGPU. Nunca Points com loop JS."

CODIGO 4: A TRANSICAO IMPOSSIVEL - FLIP DA LINEAR
================================================================================

Segredo: Linear quando clica num card, ele expande para modal sem flash. Não é route. É Flip.getState() + absolute + scale.

Código que domina:
import Flip from 'gsap/Flip'

function expandCard(card){
  const state = Flip.getState(card, { props: "borderRadius,backgroundColor" })

  card.classList.add('expanded') // CSS: position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;

  Flip.from(state, {
    duration: 0.7,
    ease: 'power2.inOut',
    absolute: true, // segredo: usa position absolute durante animação para não quebrar layout
    scale: true,
    simple: true,
    onEnter: (elements) => gsap.from(elements, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }),
    onLeave: (elements) => gsap.to(elements, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 })
  })
}

Para lista:
function filterList(){
  const state = Flip.getState('.card')
  // muda DOM: esconde alguns cards
  document.querySelectorAll('.card.hidden').forEach(c=>c.style.display='none')
  Flip.from(state, {
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: 'power2.out',
    stagger: 0.02,
    absolute: true
  })
}

Domina porque: Todo mundo faz modal com opacity. Flip faz layout animar como se fosse nativo.

Treino agente: "Para expandir card, lista, ou mudar layout, sempre Flip.getState + Flip.from com absolute:true. Nunca top/left manual."

CODIGO 5: O TEXTO QUE DERRETE - BRUNO SIMON E ACTIVE THEORY
================================================================================

Segredo: Texto que derrete não é SplitText. É SDF + shader + displacement.

Código:
import SplitType from 'split-type'
const text = new SplitType('.melt-text', { types: 'chars' })

text.chars.forEach((char, i)=>{
  // Cada char é um canvas com shader
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { uProgress: { value: 0 }, uTime: { value: 0 } },
    vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      #include "lygia/generative/cnoise.glsl"
      uniform float uProgress;
      uniform float uTime;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main(){
        vec2 uv = vUv;
        uv.y -= uProgress * 0.5; // derrete pra baixo
        uv.x += cnoise(uv * 5.0 + uTime) * uProgress * 0.2; // ruído aumenta com progress
        float alpha = 1.0 - uProgress;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(0.0), alpha);
      }
    `
  })

  gsap.to(mat.uniforms.uProgress, {
    value: 1,
    duration: 1.2,
    delay: i * 0.02,
    ease: 'power2.in',
    scrollTrigger: {
      trigger: char,
      start: 'top 80%',
      toggleActions: 'play none none reverse'
    }
  })
})

Domina porque: SplitText sozinho é só y. Com shader cnoise, derrete orgânico.

Treino agente: "Para texto premium, SplitType + shader com cnoise + uProgress por char. Nunca só GSAP y."

CODIGO 6: O HOVER QUE DISTORCE - STRIPE E AWWWARDS
================================================================================

Segredo: Imagem que distorce no hover não é filter: blur. É OGL com displacement texture + uMouse.

Código OGL que domina (12kB, não Pixi):
import { Renderer, Camera, Transform, Plane, Program, Mesh, Texture } from 'ogl'

const renderer = new Renderer({ dpr: Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio) })
const gl = renderer.gl
document.body.appendChild(gl.canvas)

const geometry = new Plane(gl, { width: 1, height: 1, widthSegments: 20, heightSegments: 20 })

const program = new Program(gl, {
  vertex: `
    attribute vec3 position;
    attribute vec2 uv;
    uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;
    uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform vec2 uMouse;
    uniform float uHover;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vUv = uv;
      vec3 pos = position;
      float dist = distance(uv, uMouse);
      pos.z += sin(dist * 10.0 - uTime * 2.0) * uHover * 0.1;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragment: `
    precision highp float;
    uniform sampler2D tMap;
    uniform float uHover;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vec2 uv = vUv;
      uv.x += sin(uv.y * 10.0) * uHover * 0.01;
      gl_FragColor = texture2D(tMap, uv);
    }
  `,
  uniforms: {
    tMap: { value: new Texture(gl, { image: new Image() }) },
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uMouse: { value: [0.5,0.5] },
    uHover: { value: 0 }
  }
})

const mesh = new Mesh(gl, { geometry, program })

// Hover:
el.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
  program.uniforms.uMouse.value = [(e.clientX - rect.left)/rect.width, 1.0 - (e.clientY - rect.top)/rect.height]
})

el.addEventListener('pointerenter', ()=> gsap.to(program.uniforms.uHover, { value: 1, duration: 0.6 }))
el.addEventListener('pointerleave', ()=> gsap.to(program.uniforms.uHover, { value: 0, duration: 0.8 }))

Domina porque: CSS hover é 2D. OGL é 3D com vértice.

Treino agente: "Para hover premium, OGL Plane + uMouse + uHover. Nunca CSS transform."

CODIGO 7: O TEMPO QUE NAO VOLTA - LETHE - CODIGO MAIS PODEROSO
================================================================================

Segredo: Site que não deixa voltar atrás cria valor. É maxProgress.

Código que domina tudo:
let maxProgress = 0
let isErasing = false

lenis.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  if(isErasing) return

  if(progress > maxProgress){
    maxProgress = progress

    // Apaga memórias com stagger + ruído humano
    document.querySelectorAll('.memory').forEach((el, i)=>{
      const triggerProgress = i / document.querySelectorAll('.memory').length
      if(maxProgress > triggerProgress){
        const delay = Math.random() * 0.2
        gsap.to(el, {
          opacity: 0,
          y: -50,
          scale: 0.9,
          filter: 'blur(20px) grayscale(1)',
          duration: 1.2,
          delay,
          ease: 'power2.in',
          onComplete: ()=> el.style.display = 'none'
        })
      }
    })

    // GPGPU apaga
    gpgpuUniforms.uErase.value = maxProgress

    if(maxProgress > 0.95 && !isErasing){
      isErasing = true
      gsap.to('.final-white', { opacity: 1, duration: 2, onComplete: ()=>{
        document.body.innerHTML = '<div class="void">Algumas coisas só existem se você não tentar guardar. <button onclick="location.reload()">Recomeçar</button></div>'
      }})
    }
  }
})

Domina porque: Quebra expectativa de scroll reversível. Cria ritual, não página.

Treino agente: "Para criar arte com peso emocional, use maxProgress que só aumenta. Nunca progress que volta."

================================================================================
CODIGO 8: A FISICA QUE SENTE - RAPIER + SPRING DA LINEAR
================================================================================

Segredo: Botão da Linear não usa ease. Usa spring com damping que sente velocity do pointer.

Código:
import { useSpring, animated } from '@react-spring/web'

const [props, api] = useSpring(()=> ({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, config: { tension: 300, friction: 20 } }))

function onPointerMove(e){
  const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
  const x = (e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width/2) * 0.1
  const y = (e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height/2) * 0.1
  api.start({ x, y, scale: 1.05 })
}

function onPointerLeave(){
  api.start({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 })
}

<animated.div style={{ x: props.x, y: props.y, scale: props.scale }} />

Com Rapier para 3D que sente:
import { RigidBody } from '@react-three/rapier'

<RigidBody type="dynamic" colliders="ball" linearDamping={0.5} angularDamping={0.5}>
  <mesh onPointerMove={(e)=>{
    const impulse = { x: e.movementX * 0.01, y: e.movementY * 0.01, z: 0 }
    body.applyImpulse(impulse)
  }}>
    <sphereGeometry />
  </mesh>
</RigidBody>

Domina porque: Spring sente, ease não sente.

Treino agente: "Para interação que sente, spring com tension/friction, não ease. Para 3D, Rapier impulse baseado em movementX."

export function RitualPage(){

    let maxProgress = 0
    lenis.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
      lastScroll = performance.now()
      maxProgress = Math.max(maxProgress, progress)

      document.querySelectorAll('.memory').forEach((el,i)=>{
        if(maxProgress > i * 0.1){
          gsap.to(el, { opacity: 0, y: -30, duration: 1, delay: Math.random()*0.2 })
        }
      })
    })

    function raf(t){
      lenis.raf(t)
      const idle = (performance.now() - lastScroll) / 1000
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle', Math.min(5, idle))
      requestAnimationFrame(raf)
    }
    raf()

    // 3. Hover que distorce (Código 6)
    document.querySelectorAll('.distort').forEach(el=>{
      // OGL setup aqui
    })

    // 4. Texto que derrete (Código 5)
    // SplitType + shader

    // 5. Transição impossível (Código 4)
    // Flip

  },[])

  return (
    <>
      <div className="void" style={{ height: '30vh' }} /> {/* Código 9: vazio */}
      <section className="hero">
        <div className="halo" /> {/* Código 2: luz que respira */}
        <h1 className="melt-text">Você não vê o que está lá. Você vê onde ilumina.</h1>
      </section>
      <section className="memories">
        {Array.from({length: 10}).map((_,i)=>(

            Memória {i}
          </div>
        ))}

    </>

// Treino agente superior 3
import Lenis from 'lenis'

import * as THREE from 'three'

const lenis3 = new Lenis({ duration: 1.3 })

gsap.ticker.add((t)=> lenis3.raf(t*1000))
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress3 = 0
let lastScroll3 = performance.now()
let idle3 = 0

lenis3.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll3 = performance.now()
  maxProgress3 = Math.max(maxProgress3, progress)
  const v = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01

  // Código 4: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-3', {
    opacity: 1 - maxProgress3,
    y: -maxProgress3 * 100,
    filter: `blur(${maxProgress3 * 20}px)`,
    duration: 0.5,
    stagger: 0.02
  })

  gsap.to('.halo-3', { scale: 1 + v + idle3 * 0.05, duration: 0.8 })
})

function raf3(t){
  lenis3.raf(t)
  idle3 = (performance.now() - lastScroll3) / 1000
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-3', Math.min(5, idle3))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf3)
}
raf3()

// Shader 3 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat3 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 3

      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

gsap.registerPlugin(Flip)

let maxProgress25 = 0

}
raf25()

// Shader 25 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat25 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 25

gsap.registerPlugin(Flip)
const state25 = Flip.getState('.card-25')

--- PADRAO AGENTE 40 - CODIGO 1 ---
// Treino agente superior 40
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import ScrollTrigger from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'
import * as THREE from 'three'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

const lenis40 = new Lenis({ duration: 1.0 })
lenis40.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
gsap.ticker.add((t)=> lenis40.raf(t*1000))
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress40 = 0
let lastScroll40 = performance.now()
let idle40 = 0

lenis40.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll40 = performance.now()
  maxProgress40 = Math.max(maxProgress40, progress)
  const v = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01

  // Código 1: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-40', {
    opacity: 1 - maxProgress40,
    y: -maxProgress40 * 100,
    filter: `blur(${maxProgress40 * 20}px)`,
    duration: 0.5,
    stagger: 0.02
  })

  gsap.to('.halo-40', { scale: 1 + v + idle40 * 0.05, duration: 0.8 })
})

function raf40(t){
  lenis40.raf(t)
  idle40 = (performance.now() - lastScroll40) / 1000
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-40', Math.min(5, idle40))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf40)
}
raf40()

// Shader 40 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat40 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 40
import Flip from 'gsap/Flip'
gsap.registerPlugin(Flip)
const state40 = Flip.getState('.card-40')

// Shader 47 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat47 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;

function raf62(t){
  lenis62.raf(t)

  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-62', Math.min(5, idle62))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf62)
}
raf62()

// Shader 62 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat62 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 62

      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

let maxProgress84 = 0

let idle84 = 0

lenis84.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll84 = performance.now()

  gsap.to('.memory-84', {

// Shader 84 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat84 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 84
import Flip from 'gsap/Flip'
gsap.registerPlugin(Flip)
const state84 = Flip.getState('.card-84')
document.querySelector('.card-84').classList.add('expanded-84')
Flip.from(state84, { duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.inOut', absolute: true, scale: true })

// Treino agente superior 99
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import ScrollTrigger from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'
import * as THREE from 'three'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

const lenis99 = new Lenis({ duration: 1.9 })
lenis99.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
gsap.ticker.add((t)=> lenis99.raf(t*1000))
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress99 = 0
let lastScroll99 = performance.now()
let idle99 = 0

lenis99.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll99 = performance.now()
  maxProgress99 = Math.max(maxProgress99, progress)
  const v = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01

  // Código 10: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-99', {
    opacity: 1 - maxProgress99,
    y: -maxProgress99 * 100,
    filter: `blur(${maxProgress99 * 20}px)`,
    duration: 0.5,
    stagger: 0.02
  })

  gsap.to('.halo-99', { scale: 1 + v + idle99 * 0.05, duration: 0.8 })
})

function raf99(t){
  lenis99.raf(t)
  idle99 = (performance.now() - lastScroll99) / 1000
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-99', Math.min(5, idle99))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf99)
}
raf99()

// Shader 99 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat99 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Shader 106 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat106 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;

// Treino agente superior 121

let maxProgress121 = 0

let idle121 = 0

lenis121.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{

  gsap.to('.memory-121', {

    y: -maxProgress121 * 100,

    stagger: 0.02

  gsap.to('.halo-121', { scale: 1 + v + idle121 * 0.05, duration: 0.8 })
})

function raf121(t){
  lenis121.raf(t)
  idle121 = (performance.now() - lastScroll121) / 1000
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-121', Math.min(5, idle121))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf121)
}
raf121()

// Shader 121 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat121 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 121

      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Shader 143 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat143 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Shader 158 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)

    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"

      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;

// Shader 165 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat165 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;

// Treino agente superior 180
import Lenis from 'lenis'

import * as THREE from 'three'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

const lenis180 = new Lenis({ duration: 1.0 })
lenis180.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
gsap.ticker.add((t)=> lenis180.raf(t*1000))
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress180 = 0
let lastScroll180 = performance.now()
let idle180 = 0

lenis180.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll180 = performance.now()
  maxProgress180 = Math.max(maxProgress180, progress)
  const v = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01

  // Código 1: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-180', {
    opacity: 1 - maxProgress180,
    y: -maxProgress180 * 100,
    filter: `blur(${maxProgress180 * 20}px)`,
    duration: 0.5,
    stagger: 0.02
  })

  gsap.to('.halo-180', { scale: 1 + v + idle180 * 0.05, duration: 0.8 })
})

function raf180(t){
  lenis180.raf(t)
  idle180 = (performance.now() - lastScroll180) / 1000
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-180', Math.min(5, idle180))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf180)
}
raf180()

// Shader 180 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat180 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 180

      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress202 = 0
let lastScroll202 = performance.now()
let idle202 = 0

lenis202.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll202 = performance.now()
  maxProgress202 = Math.max(maxProgress202, progress)
  const v = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01

  // Código 3: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-202', {

  lenis202.raf(t)

  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-202', Math.min(5, idle202))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf202)
}
raf202()

// Shader 202 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat202 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Treino agente superior 217

gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress217 = 0

let idle217 = 0

lenis217.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll217 = performance.now()

  requestAnimationFrame(raf217)
}
raf217()

// Shader 217 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat217 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Shader 224 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat224 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;

// Shader 239 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat239 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);

      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

let maxProgress261 = 0

let idle261 = 0

lenis261.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll261 = performance.now()
  maxProgress261 = Math.max(maxProgress261, progress)

  // Código 2: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-261', {

}
raf261()

// Shader 261 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat261 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Flip 261
import Flip from 'gsap/Flip'
gsap.registerPlugin(Flip)
const state261 = Flip.getState('.card-261')

// Treino agente superior 276
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import ScrollTrigger from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'
import * as THREE from 'three'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

const lenis276 = new Lenis({ duration: 1.6 })
lenis276.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)

gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

let maxProgress276 = 0
let lastScroll276 = performance.now()
let idle276 = 0

lenis276.on('scroll', ({ progress, velocity })=>{
  lastScroll276 = performance.now()
  maxProgress276 = Math.max(maxProgress276, progress)
  const v = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01

  // Código 7: Luz que respira + Tempo que não volta + Hover que distorce
  gsap.to('.memory-276', {

  lenis276.raf(t)
  idle276 = (performance.now() - lastScroll276) / 1000
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--idle-276', Math.min(5, idle276))
  requestAnimationFrame(raf276)
}
raf276()

// Shader 276 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat276 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

// Shader 283 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat283 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;

raf298()

// Shader 298 - SDF + FBM + Palette (Lygia)
const mat298 = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uIdle: { value: 0 },
    uScrollVel: { value: 0 },
    uPointer: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5,0.5) },
    uProgress: { value: 0 }
  },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `
    #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
    #include "lygia/generative/fbm.glsl"
    #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
    varying vec2 vUv;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform float uIdle;
    uniform float uScrollVel;
    uniform vec2 uPointer;
    uniform float uProgress;
    void main(){
      vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
      st += (uPointer - 0.5) * 0.1;
      float breath = 1.0 + sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdle) * 0.1 + uScrollVel * 0.2;
      float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
      float n = fbm(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.15;
      d += n;
      vec3 col = palette(d + uProgress, vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
      float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (1.0 - uProgress));
    }
  `
})

DIAGNÓSTICO DOS ORIGINAIS (o que você já tem de excelente):

Seus docs v9.3 são raros. 99% dos design systems falam de cor bonita. Você fala de Reality Lock, Evidence Ladder, Capability Probe, Context Recovery, Token Provenance.
Isso é engenharia de produto real, não Dribbble.

Pontos fortes que mantive:
- Design Contract com trace_id, budget, rollback
- Token layers: primitive/semantic/component/state/locale/motion/spatial
- Renderer ladder A-E (HTML -> WebGPU com fallback)
- Memory cleanup e context loss
- Accessibility equivalent

Limitação artística dos originais:
- Focam em não quebrar, não em emocionar. Falam de fallback mas não de poesia.
- Tokens são cores, não são luz. Motion é duração, não é respiração.
- 3D é custo, não é ritual.
- Falta camada de beleza: SDF, fluid, GPGPU, imperfeição humana.

O QUE MUDEI PARA 100x - PRINCÍPIOS:

1. SEM DEPENDÊNCIA EXCLUSIVA:
- Nada que só funcione com microfone, voz, câmera, ou VR.
- Todo input é progressivo: pointer -> scroll -> time -> keyboard -> idle -> (mic opcional como enhancement, nunca requisito)
- Se mic falhar, arte continua respirando via scroll/time.

2. BELEZA COMO SISTEMA, NÃO EFEITO:
- Tokens agora têm luz, não só cor. --glow-cobalt, --blur-aura, --noise-subtle
- Motion não é easing, é respiração: duration com variação humana, delay com ruído
- Shader é token: --sdf-circle, --fluid-velocity

3. ARTE COMO RITUAL SEM HARDWARE:
- HALO v2: respira com scroll velocity + idle time, não com mic
- LETHE: memória que apaga com scroll progress (já sem mic, perfeito)
- LUMEN: luz que segue pointer + keyboard focus, não voz

================================================================================
3D DELIVERY GATE v10 - ARTE SUPREMA SEM DEPENDÊNCIA EXCLUSIVA
================================================================================

Renderer Ladder v10 - com arte em cada tier:

Tier A - HTML/CSS/SVG - Arte com CSS: SDF via box-shadow, noise via SVG filter, breath via CSS animation. Não é fallback feio, é arte minimalista.

Tier B - Canvas 2D - Fluid 2D com p5.js, 100 partículas, sem WebGL. Arte generativa que roda em Moto G.

Tier C - WebGL2 + Lygia + Theatre.js - SDF, fbm, palette, 3D com luz. Probe de GPU, se falhar vai pra B.

Tier D - WebGPU + GPGPU - 50k partículas, fluid, compute. Só se capability + memory ok. Senão C.

Tier E - Poster + HTML + texto equivalente - Foto do resultado 3D + descrição poética. Nunca tela preta.

Input Ladder - sem dependência exclusiva:

1. Pointer (mouse/touch) - posição, velocity, pressure
2. Scroll (Lenis/ScrollSmoother) - progress, velocity, direction
3. Time + Idle - uTime, idleTime, breathTime (respira sozinho se usuário parar)
4. Keyboard - Tab, Enter, Arrow, Space (navegação ritual)
5. Reduced motion - mantém luz, remove escala
6. (Opcional) Mic/Voice - enhancement, nunca requisito. Se tiver, adiciona uMic como perturbação sutil, não controle principal.

Capability Probe v10:
function probeCapability(){
  return {
    webgpu: !!navigator.gpu,
    webgl2: !!document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl2'),
    dpr: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2),
    memory: navigator.deviceMemory || 4,
    cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4,
    touch: 'ontouchstart' in window,
    reducedMotion: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  }
}

Se webgpu false, usa webgl2. Se webgl2 false, usa canvas2d. Se canvas2d pesado, usa CSS.

3 TEMPLATES AUTORAIS v10 - SEM MICROFONE, 100x MAIS BELO

TEMPLATE 1: HALO v2 - RESPIRAÇÃO VIA SCROLL + IDLE, NÃO MIC
Nome: HALO - O SITE QUE RESPIRA COM VOCÊ, SEM PRECISAR DE MIC

Conceito: Site tem ritmo próprio. Quando você scrolla rápido, ele ofega. Quando para, ele respira fundo. Luz central pulsa com idle time, não com sopro.

Tech stack sem mic:
- Lenis para scroll velocity
- Theatre.js para breath timeline
- Lygia circleSDF + cnoise para halo orgânico
- R3F ShaderMaterial com uScrollVelocity + uIdleTime + uTime

Código:
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'

const HaloMaterial = shaderMaterial(
  { uTime: 0, uScrollVelocity: 0, uIdleTime: 0, uPointer: [0,0] },
  // vertex
  `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  // fragment com Lygia
  `
  #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
  #include "lygia/generative/cnoise.glsl"
  #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
  varying vec2 vUv;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uScrollVelocity;
  uniform float uIdleTime;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;

  void main(){
    vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    st += uPointer * 0.1; // segue pointer sutil

    float breath = sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdleTime) * 0.1 + 1.0;
    breath += uScrollVelocity * 0.2; // scroll rápido aumenta

    float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
    float n = cnoise(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.1) * 0.1;
    d += n;

    vec3 color = palette(d + uTime * 0.05, vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
    float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, alpha * 0.6);
  }
  `
)

const lenis = new Lenis()
let idleTime = 0
let lastScroll = 0

lenis.on('scroll', ({ velocity })=>{
  lenis.raf
  lastScroll = performance.now()
  material.uniforms.uScrollVelocity.value = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01
})

function raf(time){
  lenis.raf(time)
  const now = performance.now()
  idleTime = (now - lastScroll) / 1000 // segundos parado
  material.uniforms.uIdleTime.value = idleTime
  material.uniforms.uTime.value = time * 0.001
  requestAnimationFrame(raf)
}
raf()

Narrativa: Quando usuário para de scrollar, halo respira fundo, texto aparece devagar. Pressa ofega, calma revela. Sem mic, sem permissão, só tempo.

A11y: reduced-motion remove escala, mantém luz. Keyboard: Tab navega, Enter inspira (força breath). Poster: SVG halo estático + texto.

================================================================================
TEMPLATE 2: LETHE - MEMÓRIA QUE APAGA COM SCROLL (JÁ PERFEITO, SEM MIC)
Nome: LETHE - O SITE QUE ESQUECE QUANTO MAIS VOCÊ VÊ

Conceito: Cada seção que você passa apaga. Fotos viram partículas, textos viram ruído, no fim só branco. Não volta. Scroll pra cima não recupera. Único jeito de rever é ritual de recarregar com intenção.

Tech:
- Lenis + ScrollSmoother para progress que só aumenta (maxProgress)
- GPGPU 50k partículas com vida = 1 - progress
- OGL ou R3F para fluid
- Theatre.js para timeline de apagamento

Código v10 melhorado sem mic:
let maxProgress = 0
lenis.on('scroll', ({ progress })=>{
  maxProgress = Math.max(maxProgress, progress)
  // Apaga com clamp, nunca volta
  document.querySelectorAll('.memory').forEach((el, i)=>{
    const delay = i * 0.05
    const localProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (maxProgress - delay) * 1.5))
    el.style.opacity = 1 - localProgress
    el.style.filter = `blur(${localProgress * 20}px) grayscale(${localProgress})`
    el.style.transform = `translateY(${localProgress * -50}px) scale(${1 - localProgress * 0.1})`
  })

  // GPGPU
  gpgpuMaterial.uniforms.uErase.value = maxProgress
})

GPGPU shader:
uniform float uErase;
void main(){
  float life = 1.0 - uErase + random() * 0.1;
  if(life < 0.0) discard;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(position, life);
}

Narrativa: Sobre desapego. Cada memória tem 5s para ser lida antes de apagar. Usuário aprende a ler devagar. Final branco com frase: "Algumas coisas só existem se você não tentar guardar."

A11y: Versão estática mostra tudo sem apagar, com aviso: "Esta versão preserva memórias". Keyboard: Space apaga próxima memória com controle.

================================================================================
TEMPLATE 3: LUMEN v2 - LUZ QUE SEGUE POINTER + FOCUS, NÃO VOZ
Nome: LUMEN - O SITE QUE SÓ ILUMINA ONDE VOCÊ OLHA

Conceito: Site todo escuro (obsidian). Só ilumina onde pointer passa ou onde keyboard focus está. Texto só aparece na luz. Se você move rápido, luz grande mas difusa. Se move devagar, luz pequena e nítida. Sussurro virou lentidão, grito virou velocidade.

Tech:
- Pointer tracking com velocity
- Lygia light + SDF
- R3F + shader com uLightPos + uVelocity
- Theatre.js para luz que respira

Código sem voz, com pointer:
const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, velocity: 0 }
let lastX = 0, lastY = 0, lastTime = 0

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
  const now = performance.now()
  const dx = e.clientX - lastX
  const dy = e.clientY - lastY
  const dt = now - lastTime
  const velocity = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) / dt

  pointer.x = e.clientX / innerWidth
  pointer.y = 1.0 - e.clientY / innerHeight
  pointer.velocity = Math.min(1, velocity * 0.1)

  material.uniforms.uLightPos.value = [pointer.x, pointer.y]
  material.uniforms.uVelocity.value = pointer.velocity

  lastX = e.clientX
  lastY = e.clientY
  lastTime = now
})

// Keyboard: Tab move luz para elemento focado
document.addEventListener('focusin', (e)=>{
  const rect = e.target.getBoundingClientRect()

uniform float uVelocity;

void main(){

}

Renderer Ladder v10 - com arte em cada tier:

Tier A - HTML/CSS/SVG - Arte com CSS: SDF via box-shadow, noise via SVG filter, breath via CSS animation. Não é fallback feio, é arte minimalista.

Tier B - Canvas 2D - Fluid 2D com p5.js, 100 partículas, sem WebGL. Arte generativa que roda em Moto G.

Tier C - WebGL2 + Lygia + Theatre.js - SDF, fbm, palette, 3D com luz. Probe de GPU, se falhar vai pra B.

Tier D - WebGPU + GPGPU - 50k partículas, fluid, compute. Só se capability + memory ok. Senão C.

Tier E - Poster + HTML + texto equivalente - Foto do resultado 3D + descrição poética. Nunca tela preta.

Input Ladder - sem dependência exclusiva:

1. Pointer (mouse/touch) - posição, velocity, pressure
2. Scroll (Lenis/ScrollSmoother) - progress, velocity, direction
3. Time + Idle - uTime, idleTime, breathTime (respira sozinho se usuário parar)
4. Keyboard - Tab, Enter, Arrow, Space (navegação ritual)
5. Reduced motion - mantém luz, remove escala
6. (Opcional) Mic/Voice - enhancement, nunca requisito. Se tiver, adiciona uMic como perturbação sutil, não controle principal.

Capability Probe v10:
function probeCapability(){
  return {
    webgpu: !!navigator.gpu,
    webgl2: !!document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl2'),
    dpr: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2),
    memory: navigator.deviceMemory || 4,
    cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4,
    touch: 'ontouchstart' in window,
    reducedMotion: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  }
}

Se webgpu false, usa webgl2. Se webgl2 false, usa canvas2d. Se canvas2d pesado, usa CSS.

TEMPLATE 1: HALO v2 - RESPIRAÇÃO VIA SCROLL + IDLE, NÃO MIC
Nome: HALO - O SITE QUE RESPIRA COM VOCÊ, SEM PRECISAR DE MIC

Conceito: Site tem ritmo próprio. Quando você scrolla rápido, ele ofega. Quando para, ele respira fundo. Luz central pulsa com idle time, não com sopro.

Tech stack sem mic:
- Lenis para scroll velocity
- Theatre.js para breath timeline
- Lygia circleSDF + cnoise para halo orgânico
- R3F ShaderMaterial com uScrollVelocity + uIdleTime + uTime

Código:
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import { shaderMaterial } from '@react-three/drei'

const HaloMaterial = shaderMaterial(
  { uTime: 0, uScrollVelocity: 0, uIdleTime: 0, uPointer: [0,0] },
  // vertex
  `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  // fragment com Lygia
  `
  #include "lygia/sdf/circleSDF.glsl"
  #include "lygia/generative/cnoise.glsl"
  #include "lygia/color/palette.glsl"
  varying vec2 vUv;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uScrollVelocity;
  uniform float uIdleTime;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;

  void main(){
    vec2 st = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    st += uPointer * 0.1; // segue pointer sutil

    float breath = sin(uTime * 0.5 + uIdleTime) * 0.1 + 1.0;
    breath += uScrollVelocity * 0.2; // scroll rápido aumenta

    float d = circleSDF(st * breath);
    float n = cnoise(st * 2.0 + uTime * 0.1) * 0.1;
    d += n;

    vec3 color = palette(d + uTime * 0.05, vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5), vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0), vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67));
    float alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, d);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, alpha * 0.6);
  }
  `
)

const lenis = new Lenis()
let idleTime = 0
let lastScroll = 0

lenis.on('scroll', ({ velocity })=>{
  lenis.raf
  lastScroll = performance.now()
  material.uniforms.uScrollVelocity.value = Math.abs(velocity) * 0.01
})

function raf(time){
  lenis.raf(time)
  const now = performance.now()
  idleTime = (now - lastScroll) / 1000 // segundos parado
  material.uniforms.uIdleTime.value = idleTime
  material.uniforms.uTime.value = time * 0.001
  requestAnimationFrame(raf)
}
raf()

Narrativa: Quando usuário para de scrollar, halo respira fundo, texto aparece devagar. Pressa ofega, calma revela. Sem mic, sem permissão, só tempo.

A11y: reduced-motion remove escala, mantém luz. Keyboard: Tab navega, Enter inspira (força breath). Poster: SVG halo estático + texto.

let maxProgress = 0
lenis.on('scroll', ({ progress })=>{
  maxProgress = Math.max(maxProgress, progress)
  // Apaga com clamp, nunca volta
  document.querySelectorAll('.memory').forEach((el, i)=>{
    const delay = i * 0.05
    const localProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (maxProgress - delay) * 1.5))
    el.style.opacity = 1 - localProgress
    el.style.filter = `blur(${localProgress * 20}px) grayscale(${localProgress})`
    el.style.transform = `translateY(${localProgress * -50}px) scale(${1 - localProgress * 0.1})`
  })

  // GPGPU
  gpgpuMaterial.uniforms.uErase.value = maxProgress
})

GPGPU shader:
uniform float uErase;
void main(){
  float life = 1.0 - uErase + random() * 0.1;
  if(life < 0.0) discard;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(position, life);
}

Narrativa: Sobre desapego. Cada memória tem 5s para ser lida antes de apagar. Usuário aprende a ler devagar. Final branco com frase: "Algumas coisas só existem se você não tentar guardar."

TEMPLATE 3: LUMEN v2 - LUZ QUE SEGUE POINTER + FOCUS, NÃO VOZ

Código sem voz, com pointer:
const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, velocity: 0 }
let lastX = 0, lastY = 0, lastTime = 0

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e)=>{
  const now = performance.now()
  const dx = e.clientX - lastX
  const dy = e.clientY - lastY
  const dt = now - lastTime
  const velocity = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) / dt

  pointer.x = e.clientX / innerWidth
  pointer.y = 1.0 - e.clientY / innerHeight
  pointer.velocity = Math.min(1, velocity * 0.1)

  material.uniforms.uLightPos.value = [pointer.x, pointer.y]
  material.uniforms.uVelocity.value = pointer.velocity

  lastX = e.clientX
  lastY = e.clientY
  lastTime = now
})

// Keyboard: Tab move luz para elemento focado
document.addEventListener('focusin', (e)=>{
  const rect = e.target.getBoundingClientRect()
  gsap.to(material.uniforms.uLightPos.value, {
    x: (rect.left + rect.width/2) / innerWidth,
    y: 1.0 - (rect.top + rect.height/2) / innerHeight,
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  })
})

Shader:

uniform float uVelocity;

}
